title: Judge ‘Reluctantly’ Lets DOJ Dismiss Jan. 6 Oath Keepers Cases
title_cn: 法官“不情愿”地让司法部驳回 1 月 6 日的誓言守护者案件
summary: More than three years ago, the US Justice Department touted guilty verdicts against members of the right-wing Oath Keepers for plotting to obstruct Congress’ certification of the 2020 presidential election as the crowning achievement of a sprawling prosecution effort that followed violent riots at the Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021.

title: US Treasury Keeps Debt-Sale Guidance Steady
title_cn: 美国财政部保持债务销售指导稳定
summary: The US Treasury retained its previous guidance for future debt issuance, signaling no change in note and bond auction sizes well into 2027. The quarterly refunding will raise about $28.7 billion in new cash. Auctions will be held on August 11, 12 and 13. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Deportation Orders Surge to Record as Hardliners Want More
title_cn: 特朗普驱逐令激增，强硬派想要更多
summary: The US is winning more deportation orders than ever in a sign that President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown is gaining traction.

title: Lula Battles Trump, Milei Over Perceived Election Meddling
title_cn: 卢拉因特朗普、米莱涉嫌干预选举而与特朗普作斗争
summary: Brazil plunged deeper into diplomatic disputes with two of its most important partners in the Americas over what it described as attempts by the conservative governments of the US and Argentina to interfere in its October presidential election.
